q1: SELECT b.name AS bar, COUNT(DISTINCT f.drinker) AS num_drinker, AVG(s.price) AS avg_price, (SELECT f1.drinker FROM frequents AS f1 WHERE f1.bar = b.name ORDER BY f1.times_a_week DESC, f1.drinker ASC LIMIT 1) AS most_reg_drinker FROM bar AS b LEFT JOIN frequents AS f ON b.name = f.bar LEFT JOIN serves AS s ON b.name = s.bar GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY num_drinker DESC, b.name ASC
q2: SELECT f1.total_count, f1.bar, s1.avg_price, f2.drinker FROM (SELECT frequents.bar, COUNT(frequents.drinker) AS total_count FROM frequents GROUP BY bar ORDER BY bar ASC) AS f1, (SELECT serves.bar, AVG(serves.price) AS avg_price FROM serves GROUP BY bar ORDER BY bar ASC) AS s1, (SELECT ft.bar, ft.drinker, ft.times_a_week FROM frequents AS ft, (SELECT frequents.bar, MAX(frequents.times_a_week) AS times_max FROM frequents GROUP BY bar ORDER BY bar ASC) AS bar_max WHERE ft.bar = bar_max.bar AND ft.times_a_week = bar_max.times_max ORDER BY ft.drinker ASC) AS f2 WHERE f1.bar = s1.bar AND f1.bar = f2.bar AND s1.bar = f2.bar ORDER BY f1.total_count ASC
